title: Last user can't sell all his wearables
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, user can be unable to sell if has only 1 share of Wearable  **Likelihood:** Medium, the last user to sell will get the error.  ## Description  Price calculation rounds down in both situations: buy and sell. Therefore buy price can be lower than the sell price if dividing one purchase into several batches, that's because of rounding down.  There is a possible situation when a lower price is paid on `buy` compared to the `sell`.
